stanzas.sanskrit:
तव विलोकनाद्गोपिकाजनाः
प्रमदसङ्कुलाः पङ्कजेक्षण ।
अमृतधारया सम्प्लुता इव
स्तिमिततां दधुस्त्वत्पुरोगताः ॥ ६८-१ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Krishna appeared before the Gopikas all of a sudden and seeing HIM, they stood like a statue and fully drenched in the immortal bliss.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tava vilokanādgopikājanāḥ
pramadasaṅkulāḥ paṅkajekṣaṇa |
amṛtadhārayā samplutā iva
stimitatāṃ dadhustvatpurogatāḥ || 68-1 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
तदनु काचन त्वत्कराम्बुजं
सपदि गृह्णती निर्विशङ्कितम् ।
घनपयोधरे संविधाय सा
पुलकसंवृता तस्थुषी चिरम् ॥ ६८-२ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: One of the Gopika took HIS lotus flower like hand and placed it on her chest and stood like that for a long time with her body experiencing goosebumps.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tadanu kācana tvatkarāmbujaṃ
sapadi gṛhṇatī nirviśaṅkitam |
ghanapayodhare saṃvidhāya sā
pulakasaṃvṛtā tasthuṣī ciram || 68-2 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
तव विभोऽपरा कोमलं भुजं
निजगलान्तरे पर्यवेष्टयत् ।
गलसमुद्गतं प्राणमारुतं
प्रतिनिरुन्धतीवातिहर्षुला ॥ ६८-३ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: One of the Gopikas, took HIS arm and put it around her neck as if she was trying to avoid the breath going out of her neck in the pain of separation.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tava vibho’parā komalaṃ bhujaṃ
nijagalāntare paryaveṣṭayat |
galasamudgataṃ prāṇamārutaṃ
pratinirundhatīvātiharṣulā || 68-3 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
अपगतत्रपा कापि कामिनी
तव मुखाम्बुजात् पूगचर्वितम् ।
प्रतिगृहय्य तद्वक्त्रपङ्कजे
निदधती गता पूर्णकामताम् ॥ ६८-४ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Another Gopika, out of her extreme love, without shyness, took the chewed betel leaf from Krishna's mouth and put it in hers and felt she has attained the supreme bliss.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
apagatatrapā kāpi kāminī
tava mukhāmbujāt pūgacarvitam |
pratigṛhayya tadvaktrapaṅkaje
nidadhatī gatā pūrṇakāmatām || 68-4 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
विकरुणो वने संविहाय मा-
-मपगतोऽसि का त्वामिह स्पृशेत् ।
इति सरोषया तावदेकया
सजललोचनं वीक्षितो भवान् ॥ ६८-५ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: One of them stood gazing at Krishna with anger in her tearful eyes, as if to ask HIM the reason for Krishna disappearing and leaving from the forest.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
vikaruṇo vane saṃvihāya mā-
-mapagato’si kā tvāmiha spṛśet |
iti saroṣayā tāvadekayā
sajalalocanaṃ vīkṣito bhavān || 68-5 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
इति मुदाकुलैर्वल्लवीजनैः
सममुपागतो यामुने तटे ।
मृदुकुचाम्बरैः कल्पितासने
घुसृणभासुरे पर्यशोभथाः ॥ ६८-६ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: All the Gopikas made a seat for Krishna in the banks of river Yamuna with their saffron colour upper drape. Krishna sat on it with all splendour and shining glory.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
iti mudākulairvallavījanaiḥ
samamupāgato yāmune taṭe |
mṛdukucāmbaraiḥ kalpitāsane
ghusṛṇabhāsure paryaśobhathāḥ || 68-6 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
कतिविधा कृपा केऽपि सर्वतो
धृतदयोदयाः केचिदाश्रिते ।
कतिचिदीदृशा मादृशेष्वपी-
-त्यभिहितो भवान् वल्लवीजनैः ॥ ६८-७ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Gopikas questioned Krishna as to what type of mercy HE is showing to them as some people have compassion for everyone, some have compassion for their dependents but Krishna didn't even show compassion to Gopikas who gave up house, family, everything for Krishna and surrendered to HIM.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
katividhā kṛpā ke’pi sarvato
dhṛtadayodayāḥ kecidāśrite |
katicidīdṛśā mādṛśeṣvapī-
-tyabhihito bhavān vallavījanaiḥ || 68-7 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
अयि कुमारिका नैव शङ्क्यतां
कठिनता मयि प्रेमकातरे ।
मयि तु चेतसो वोऽनुवृत्तये
कृतमिदं मयेत्यूचिवान् भवान् ॥ ६८-८ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
ayi kumārikā naiva śaṅkyatāṃ
kaṭhinatā mayi premakātare |
mayi tu cetaso vo’nuvṛttaye
kṛtamidaṃ mayetyūcivān bhavān || 68-8 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
अयि निशम्यतां जीववल्लभाः
प्रियतमो जनो नेदृशो मम ।
तदिह रम्यतां रम्ययामिनी-
-ष्वनुपरोधमित्यालपो विभो ॥ ६८-९ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: HE promised to Gopikas, that none other than them are dear to HIM and so asked them to enjoy the beautiful moon-lit night along the river Yamuna with HIM happily without any obstruction.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
ayi niśamyatāṃ jīvavallabhāḥ
priyatamo jano nedṛśo mama |
tadiha ramyatāṃ ramyayāminī-
-ṣvanuparodhamityālapo vibho || 68-9 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
इति गिराधिकं मोदमेदुरै-
-र्व्रजवधूजनैः साकमारमन् ।
कलितकौतुको रासखेलने
गुरुपुरीपते पाहि मां गदात् ॥ ६८-१० ॥
stanzas.commentary_en:
As Krishna approached home, Gopikas rushed to recieve him on hearing the beautiful notes of Krishna's flute, and were happy to see him. Nandagopan and Yashoda were also delighted to see Krishna.
Bhattathiri prays to Guruvayurappa, to cure him of all his diseases.
Gopikas joy found no limit at HIS declaration and they spent all night with full of enthusiasm. Bhattathiri prayed to Bhagwan who had sported *RASALEELA*, to end his sufferings.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
iti girādhikaṃ modamedurai-
-rvrajavadhūjanaiḥ sākamāraman |
kalitakautuko rāsakhelane
gurupurīpate pāhi māṃ gadāt || 68-10 ||
